title: Lagoon Markdown package manifest v2, specification revision 2.0
description: Structural schema for lagoon.json. Unicode grapheme-cluster length limits and archive-entry validation require additional implementation checks.
$comment: Image bytes, square thumbnail dimensions, ZIP paths, and media signatures cannot be validated by this manifest-only schema.

formatVersion.$comment: JSON Schema treats 2 and 2.0 as the same integer value. Writers should emit the canonical JSON token 2.

title.$comment: Must contain at most 120 extended grapheme clusters. JSON Schema maxLength is intentionally omitted because it counts Unicode code points.

description.$comment: Must contain at most 500 extended grapheme clusters. JSON Schema maxLength is intentionally omitted because it counts Unicode code points.

thumbnail.$comment: The referenced root-level PNG, JPEG, or WebP file must decode to equal pixel width and height. JSON Schema cannot inspect archive entries or image dimensions.
